# Go live with Adobe CJA faster, and less data maintenance.

Quantum Metric accelerates Customer Journey Analytics migration while continuously enriching Adobe Experience Platform with trusted behavioral data, so teams go live in weeks and keep CJA reliable as experiences and teams change.

## Faster adoption. Less maintenance. Better insight inside Adobe.

### Fast, low-risk CJA migration.

Migrate to Customer Journey Analytics in weeks—not months or years—without rebuilding tagging or instrumentation from scratch.

### Zero tagging, reduced long-term maintenance.

Dramatically reduces manual tagging and schema rework as experiences change.

### Behavioral context inside Adobe.

See frustration, errors, rage clicks, and drop-offs directly in CJA and AEP—so teams understand not just what happened, but why.

## What changes for product and analytics teams.

Reduced analytics and tagging backlog tied to XDM schema updates and event rework.

Faster access to insights that drive conversion, adoption, and self-service.

Earlier visibility into friction and revenue-impacting issues.

Stronger prioritization using quantified behavioral impact.

More effective experimentation and UX improvements powered by Adobe data.

## A simpler path to CJA—built for enterprise scale.

### CAPTURE

Quantum Metric automatically captures clicks, taps, forms, errors, and performance signals with minimal engineering effort.

### MAP

The Quantum Metric AEP Connector maps behavioral signals directly into Adobe Experience Platform and XDM schemas, eliminating ETL pipelines and data-layer rebuilds.

### GET CJA INSIGHTS

CJA is populated with high-value behavioral context, with links back to replay and summaries so teams can validate issues and act faster.

## Use cases across Adobe Experience Cloud.

### Customer Journey Analytics (CJA)

Behavioral context embedded directly into journey analysis to understand why journeys break **.**

### Adobe Target

Smarter experimentation and personalization driven by real behavioral signals.

### Adobe Campaign

Journey-aware activation informed by engagement and experience quality.

### Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)

Trigger next-best actions based on live intent, friction, and behavior.

### Real-Time CDP

Higher-quality audiences built on trusted behavioral data flowing through AEP.

## FAQ

### How much implementation and ongoing maintenance is required?

Quantum Metric captures hundreds of behavioral, technical, and experience signals out of the box without manual tagging or heavy instrumentation. As experiences change, teams spend less time reworking schemas and can quickly add key business actions using Live Event Builder, without engineering.

### Who is this solution designed for?

Adobe-native digital product and analytics teams accountable for the success of Customer Journey Analytics—not just getting it live, but keeping it trusted and useful over time.

### What changes after we’re live in Adobe CJA?

Instead of point-in-time instrumentation, teams benefit from continuous behavioral capture and enrichment that keeps CJA complete and reliable as experiences evolve.

### How does this scale across teams and properties?

Quantum Metric enables centralized data capture with decentralized activation—so teams across sites, apps, and regions can move fast without creating engineering bottlenecks.
